payload.name: resolve-chat-launch
payload.description: Canonical invocation admission: resolve the caller's model and adapter identities against live model descriptors owned by this package and this package's available invocation options, then return the owner-resolved model_descriptor, launch, and provenance. Callers receive a finished admission via Envelope and never supply transport/template descriptors.

payload.name: write-model-invocation-option-record
payload.description: Write one derived ai-model-invocation-option record (or its retired tombstone). Loop body of action:publish-model-invocation-options; the record address/payload arrive fully formed from the deriver, this action is a blind writer.

payload.name: publish-model-invocation-options
payload.description: Project the live cli-registry facts (this package's own schema) into by-kind ai-model-invocation-option records, enriched with ai-model-descriptor display metadata read as DATA. Every surface's by-kind option fold then lists all runnable cloud/local/CLI models with zero surface code. Recompute-from-truth with retired tombstones; idempotent (same-content rewrites are engine no-ops).

payload.name: ingest-cli-registry-model-record
payload.description: Write one discovered cli model catalog payload into canonical cli_registry facts.

payload.name: Continue outcome (never-stop / loop continuation)
payload.description: Fires from a clock::tick loop or a session-stop, reads live outcome-continuation contracts plus operator pause receipts, and stamps the real continuation decision. Paused contracts are excluded before any replacement session can dispatch.

payload.name: Auto-allocate session (L165 receipt on session-start)
payload.description: Fires on session-start and writes a real allocation receipt proving the L165 allocation auto-happened with zero agent action. Live provider/model selection binds this package's model descriptors + cli_registry when admitted (L116 ceiling).

payload.name: Evaluate harness guard (tool-use)
payload.description: Fires from the T6 tool-use trigger. Reads the live harness-guard rows + the triggering tool-use event, runs the DATA-driven deny/allow evaluator, and stamps a real guard-verdict record. A real deny is handed to ai-action-guard when that owner is admitted (L116 ceiling).

payload.name: Pause outcome contract (operator stop)
payload.description: Fires from the T8 operator Stop trigger (session-stop-requested). Reads the live outcome-continuation contracts and stamps a real harness-stop-pause receipt naming the exact selected contract. Every continuation and dispatch owner consumes this receipt before advancing, so never-stop cannot re-fire it.

payload.name: Dispatch harness session
payload.description: On a continuation wake, read the live harness graph and cli_registry DATA, materialize one assigned-work source plus dynamic worker profile, and delegate the guarded process_session launch to process-session.

payload.name: Launch a ready harness dispatch plan
payload.description: Consume one typed ready-only harness dispatch plan, materialize its deterministic assigned-work source and worker profile, and delegate the guarded launch to process-session. A no-op or failed plan never reaches this action because the trigger admits only should_dispatch=true.

payload.name: Launch a ready harness dispatch plan
payload.description: Admit only typed ready harness plans to the guarded assigned-work launch workflow. No-open-contract, unsupported-transport, and plan-error records do not match.

payload.name: Mandate continuation on clock tick
payload.description: On each clock::tick, fire action:continue-outcome (loops-as-DATA).

payload.name: Dispatch harness on clock tick
payload.description: On each clock::tick, attempt one guarded harness self-run dispatch from the live outcome-continuation contracts.

payload.name: Auto-allocate on session start
payload.description: On session-start, fire action:auto-allocate-session (L165 allocation receipt).

payload.name: Continue on session stop
payload.description: On session-stop, fire action:continue-outcome (never-stop).

payload.name: Dispatch harness on session stop
payload.description: On session-stop, attempt one guarded harness self-run dispatch from the live outcome-continuation contracts.

payload.name: Guard on tool use
payload.description: On tool-use, fire action:evaluate-harness-guard (DATA-driven deny/allow over harness-guard rows).

payload.name: Stop on operator stop-requested
payload.description: On session-stop-requested (operator Stop), fire action:pause-outcome-contract so never-stop does not re-fire.

payload.why: carrying a chat session's lifecycle from a spawned CLI hook into the running app's write surface is what this package is for, and the hook runs OUTSIDE the engine as a separate process, so it has no target sender to send through and the HTTP POST is the only door back in; it posts one write-batch to the app URL the launcher named, buffers to disk and exits 0 when that app is unreachable, and it reaches no address it was not handed.

a CLI hook is started by the host tool, not by the engine, so the environment is the only channel the launcher has to tell it which app to write to and under which session; every knob it reads (shell URL, partition, session id, provider, path lane, sequence) is launcher-set DATA rather than a hidden default, and the pure envelope builder beside it takes all of them as arguments so nothing downstream reads the environment.

payload.name: Capture native model-visible readback
payload.description: Run the generic adapter-DATA native readback leaf against one typed harness dispatch plan. Missing, unknown, stale, or mismatched readback emits a blocked event and fails closed; a buffered event is audit evidence only.

payload.name: refresh-model-catalogs-from-declared-sources
payload.description: Read every declared model-catalog SOURCE row (the sources file named in input.sources_file, required, because no path on a customer's machine can be guessed here), fetch what each vendor serves now, rewrite each vendor catalog recompute-from-truth, re-derive every derived catalog through its exposure policy, and write the cli-registry models fact for every subject a source row names. An unreadable source keeps its previous catalog and is reported stale with last_read_on; the exit-code edge skips the fact writes so a seed is never replaced by a guess (L216).

payload.name: refresh-model-catalogs-on-workspace-loaded
payload.description: On workspace load, re-read every declared model-catalog source so vendor model lists are live, never hand-typed; cadence is min_interval_seconds in the sources file.

payload.name: refresh-model-catalogs-on-tick
payload.description: On every clock tick, re-read every declared model-catalog source so the catalog files a consumer loads at ITS startup are already current; cadence is min_interval_seconds in the sources file, so most ticks cost two file reads. This is the seam that makes the refresh precede the consumer's load instead of following a prompt.
